tests.name: Actions build, Python/C++/JS regression checks
tests.evidence: Run 39089452516 succeeded at 3284c45. Eight Python source/archive tests, C++ security/recovery tests and JS reconnect-event contract tests passed; offline bundle reproduced in CI.

tests.name: Concurrent TLS lifecycle sanitizer regression
tests.evidence: 12 real-OpenSSL concurrent read/write/peek/pending/close rounds under ASan/UBSan passed in the dedicated CI job. Includes repeated engine path free and rejection of raw writes after TLS teardown. This is host coverage, separate from device coverage.

tests.name: 100 Chrome WSS connect/disconnect cycles on physical iPhone
Final short-run crash inventory
tests.evidence: No additional trollvncserver crash reports after final install. The only recovery in the final diagnostic window is the explicitly injected SIGKILL; earlier candidate crashes are recorded separately. This is not a 24-hour pass.

tests.name: DEB signatures, architecture and offline payload

evidence.note: Local validator independently matches CI SHA256. The separate native test helper is excluded.

tests.name: Exact final DEB upgrade from 1.1.0
tests.evidence: Restored original preferences, installed verified 1.1.0 baseline, checkpointed all values, upgraded to this exact DEB and compared values before test configuration. Package SHA256 was independently verified on-device with Python (shasum was unavailable). A later comparison after intentional test configuration is expected to differ. Main server and web remained off until explicitly enabled for tests.

tests.name: Direct LAN HTTP, MIME and offline bundle
tests.evidence: Windows Chrome 155.0.8059.84 loaded the page from iPhone port 5801 and authenticated through native WS on VNC port 5901. No CDN, proxy, Node or Python server on iPhone.

tests.name: Live screen, tap and browser View-only
tests.evidence: Final package: Calculator 0 stayed unchanged for a view-only tap; the same full-access tap displayed 2. Frame hashes and local screenshots were inspected. Screenshots are not published.

tests.name: Browser mouse drag/swipe
tests.evidence: Final 3284c45 DEB repeated in Chrome/WSS on 2026-10-18: mouse drag visibly scrolled native Settings from the network section down to wallpaper, Siri and privacy controls. Local screenshots inspected; raw screens excluded.

tests.name: Server-enforced view-only password
tests.evidence: With the browser view-only toggle off, a view-only VNC credential blocked the same Calculator tap. Server restriction source is unchanged.

tests.name: Remote Control off in server preferences
tests.evidence: Full-access credential with browser view-only off remained unable to tap when RemoteControlEnabled=false. No authentication policy change.

tests.name: Auto Scale and Fullscreen
tests.evidence: Chrome entered/exited fullscreen, resized viewport and toggled scale. Canvas aspect ratio was preserved. Portrait 564x1004 and earlier landscape 1000x562 were observed; no new physical-rotation assistance claimed.

tests.name: Browser rejects wrong VNC password
tests.evidence: Entered a generated wrong credential once; browser returned to disconnected state without an authentication retry loop.

tests.name: Credential handling
tests.evidence: Observed empty password field after submission and empty local/session storage in isolated Chrome context. URL has host/ports only. Reconnect uses memory-only session credentials; manual Disconnect clears wrapper intent/credentials.

tests.name: Worker crash recovery and automatic browser reconnect
tests.evidence: Killed the package engine deliberately. Watchdog replaced the worker with backoff; Chrome reauthenticated automatically and received a framebuffer. Initial development candidate failed due to noVNC clean-close semantics; wrapper and JS regression test were corrected.

tests.name: Manual Disconnect stays disconnected
tests.evidence: After manual Disconnect, waited six seconds: no browser reconnect and Connect button remained enabled. JS regression also covers pending retry cancellation and five-attempt budget.

evidence.note: Final DEB accepted logical /var/tmp certificate/key paths without rewriting preferences. Native HTTPS and existing WSS authenticated in Chrome using isolated test-context certificate bypass for a temporary self-signed IP-SAN certificate. Default validation rejected it. Windows CA trust was not changed; a normally trusted production certificate is still user-provided.

tests.name: Bad TLS config has no plaintext fallback
HTTP/HTTPS path and method rejection
tests.evidence: Actual device rejected missing files, traversal, encoded traversal over HTTPS and POST; JavaScript MIME and exact bundled contents verified. No general CONNECT proxy enabled.

tests.name: Native VNC regression with optional web TLS unavailable
tests.evidence: Raw TCP VNC authenticated with unchanged VNC security type 2 and returned a 564x1004 framebuffer while an intentionally invalid web certificate kept port 5801 closed.

tests.name: Server survives closing Settings
tests.evidence: Terminated the verified Preferences process; both listeners remained owned by package worker and authenticated browser capture continued. Initial pkill command was unavailable; explicit verified PID termination succeeded.

tests.name: Native Settings presentation and Copy URL
tests.evidence: Opened native preference pane and observed LAN IP, generated URL, HTTP port and certificate fields. Preferences toggles were exercised through the mobile CFPreferences test helper; Copy URL was not executed to avoid modifying the owner clipboard.

tests.name: Physical Wi-Fi loss/rejoin and changed DHCP lease
tests.evidence: Owner unavailable for assisted device operations in this session. No Wi-Fi power toggle was performed. Engine-crash reconnect is a separate test and is not a Wi-Fi pass. Prior 1.1.0 interface-alias evidence remains historical.

tests.name: Keyboard-specific app acceptance / Edge
tests.evidence: Wrapper retains bundled noVNC keyboard handling; this session used Chrome. Dedicated app keyboard acceptance and Edge were not separately tested.

tests.name: 24-hour soak, reboot and memory-leak qualification
tests.evidence: Previously deferred by owner. Short CPU/RSS diagnostics and existing timeout controls do not establish leak freedom, FPS improvement or 24-hour stability.

final_state: Final 1.1.1 DEB installed. Original 17 preference values independently matched after CFPreferences flushed (Enabled=false); web/VNC/control listeners were closed. Temporary on-device test tools, package copies and TLS keys/certificates were removed. The separate TrollStore app files were retained; its conflicting server/manager remain stopped. Original clipboard was not modified.
